property_summary: Calling c.transfer with an empty _tos array must revert; the reference reverts due to require(_tos.length > 0) but the buggy version skips the loop and returns true.
A successful call to transfer(...) should never revert, but the mutant always reverts with `require(false)`.
For any input, the reference transfer returns true; the buggy version returns false when _tos.length > 0.
